parameters.description_en:
The ticket status (status value).
**Note: You must customize the status value when defining the ticket type. For example, you must manually change the status value for "pending delivery" to 3807 and complete this change before creating the ticket for the query condition to take effect. See the following image (copy the link and download to view):**
https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2020/png/2733660/1608724297862-da5150ed-71f0-47a5-8de4-c371cda23b97.png.
parameters.description_zh:
工单状态（工单状态数值）
**说明：工单类型定义时需要自定义状态数值，例如配送员待处理的状态数值需手动改为3807且在工单创建前修改完成，工单状态的查询条件才可能生效。如下图：（该图复制链接下载后即可查看）**
